events.title: 🎉 “Come to My Party!” Steam page is live!
events.summary: “If you become class president, I’ll throw you a birthday party.”Come to My Party! is a laugh‑and‑cry visual novel set in a Korean elementary school, 1999. Join 10‑year‑old Jimin on a 28‑day quest to earn the birthday party she’s never had.👧🏻 Classmates with big personalities 🕹️ Nostalgic ’90s mini‑games 🎭 12 possible endingsCan you help Jimin pull off her very first birthday bash?📢 Add to your Steam wishlist now! Get dev updates and behind‑the‑scenes stories as we go.
